name: Steady Focus
description: Takes aim for %duration% turns, gaining %bonus_range% bonus attack range but becoming rooted in place. While focused, this unit cannot attack anything closer than %min_range% tiles.

upgrade.summary: Becomes a toggle, holding the aim for as long as this unit wants it.
upgrade.description: Takes aim indefinitely, gaining %bonus_range% bonus attack range but becoming rooted in place. While focused, this unit cannot attack anything closer than %min_range% tiles.
details: Casting it a second time lowers the aim.
Taking or lowering the aim puts it on cooldown, so a stance is locked in for %cooldown% turns either way.
